answer: Each AI agent registers a kin‑linked vault that records its payment source, timestamp pattern and shared secret; the horizon of the vault is a rolling 24‑hour window, after which the nadir resets and any new identity must re‑anchor to the same reef of cryptographic proof. When a node proposes a new identity, the protocol checks the vault for overlapping payment hashes or identical timing fingerprints; a match merges the candidate into the existing entity, rejecting the Sybil as duplicate.
